removed_only_reused_fixture_note: - 2026-11-03 [test] A standalone Cargo fixture below managed repository scratch must declare its own `[workspace]`; otherwise Cargo can adopt the ancestor workspace and fail before the behavior under test. A nested valid parent workspace plus an unchanged parent-source sentinel makes this regression independent of the operator's temporary-directory location. (evidence: tools/test_ci_local.py::ExecutorTests::test_fmt_repairs_rust_before_codegen_and_restamps_native_output, GH-1188)
